# Error Codes

Every diagnostic code, with its name and the template of its message. A placeholder such as `{0}` is replaced by the diagnostic's arguments when the message is rendered. Codes are grouped by the part of the system that reports them; see [Diagnostics](/docs/language/errors-and-limits/diagnostics).

## Lexer (JM1000 to JM1999)

| Code | Name | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| JM1200 | `UnterminatedString` | Unterminated string literal |
| JM1201 | `InvalidEscapeSequence` | Invalid escape sequence in string literal: {0} |

## Parser (JM2000 to JM2999)

| Code | Name | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| JM2000 | `UnknownParserError` | Syntax error: unexpected {0} |
| JM2001 | `UnexpectedEndOfSource` | Syntax error: unexpected end of source |
| JM2002 | `SourceNestingLimitExceeded` | Exceeded the maximum source nesting depth of {0} |
| JM2003 | `CallTargetNotName` | A call must be made on a function name, not on another expression |
| JM2200 | `InvalidNumberFormat` | Invalid number format: '{0}' |
